Ἀζώρ.long: Azor, son of Eliakim and father of Zadok, an ancestor of Jesus.

ἄζυμος.long: unleavened, the paschal feast (a feast of the Hebrews); fig: uncorrupted, sincere.
ἄζυμος.sd: unleavened, i.e. (figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neutral plural) specially (by implication) the Passover week
ἄζυμος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2219 (ζύμη);
ἄζυμος.as:
ἄζυμος, -ον
(< ζύμη), [in LXX for מָצָּה; τὰ ἄ. (sc. λάγανα, cakes) = הַמָצָּה;]
unleavened: ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἄ. (הַג הַמָצָּה), the paschal feast (also called τὰ ἄ., Mk 14:1), Lk 22:1; ἡμέρα τῶν ἄ., Mt 26:17, Mk 14:12, Lk 22:7; ἡμέραι, Ac 12:320:6. Fig., of Christians, free from corruption: I Co 5:7; exhorted to keep festival, ἐν ἀζύμοις (sc. ἄρτοις, λάγανοις, or, indefinitely, "unleavened elements"), I Co 5:8 (Cremer, 724).†

Ἄζωτος.long: Azotus, Ashdod, a coast town of Palestine belonging to the ancient Philistia, and part of Herod's kingdom.
Ἄζωτος.sd: Azotus (i.e. Ashdod), a place in Palestine
Ἄζωτος.as:
Ἄζωτος, -ου, ἡ (Heb., אַשְׁדּוֹד),
Azotus, a Philistine city: Ac 8:40.†
